Theme

Time, the calendar & feasts

at the right time phrase

also at the wrong time, at a good time, at a bad time, in season, out of season, timely, opportunely, inopportunely

classical

Cato Agr. 61.1 (Lewis & Short s.v. tempestīvus)
Cic. ND 2.156 (Lewis & Short)
Traupman 88, 394

tempestīvē

adverb

at the right time, in season

Other words

  • intempestīvē — at the wrong time, out of season

    adverb · also used · classical · Cic. Off. 1.25: accēdere (Lewis & Short s.v. intempestīvus); Cic. Fam. 11.16: adīre ad aliquem (Lewis & Short); Traupman 88, 394

  • opportūnē — just at the right moment

    adverb · also used · classical

    Said on someone's arrival: opportūnē, just in time (see in the nick of time).

Examples

  • Salvum tē advenīre, Dēmea, gaudēmus. — Ehem, opportūnē: tē ipsum quaeritō.

    We’re glad to see you safely here, Demea. — Ah, just in time: you’re the very man I’m looking for.Ter. Ad. 80–81

  • tempestīvus

    in seasonTraupman 375

See also on time, in good time, moment, occasion.
